library(DBI)

options(scipen = 999)
# Cargar la tabla de superstores sales
superstore <- readr::read_csv(
  "../../data/superstore_sales.csv",
  locale = readr::locale(encoding = "Windows-1252"),
  show_col_types = FALSE
)

con <- DBI::dbConnect( 
    RSQLite::SQLite(), 
    ":memory:" 
) 

DBI::dbWriteTable( 
    con, 
    "superstore", 
    superstore, 
    overwrite = TRUE 
)

DBI::dbListTables(con) # produce:
[1] "superstore"
q1 <- DBI::dbGetQuery( 
    con, 
    ' 
SELECT *

)

q9 <- DBI::dbGetQuery( 
    con, 
    ' 
    SELECT 
      "Category", 
      SUM("Sales") AS total_sales 
    FROM superstore 
    GROUP BY "Category" 
    ORDER BY total_sales DESC 
    ' 
)
